text:
amanda_g: Quick sync — planning the mid-Dec launch. Goal: keep CPA <= $45 while scaling search + retarget. Thoughts on bid stacking and creative rotation? Brief: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link

raj_k: For search my proposal: 3-tier bid stack (brand / high-intent / broad) with daypart multipliers. Start conservative: daily budget $200 and scale by +20% daily if CTR>1.2% and conv_rate>3%. Also recommend retarget holdback at 10%.

leo: For retargeting: layering windows -> 0-3d dynamic, 4-14d static, 15-90d re-engage. Creative cadence: rotate hero image every 48h, keep messaging aligned to LP funnel.

sarah_m: UTM & routing notes: utm_campaign=middec_launch_dec, utm_source=search|retarget, utm_content=creativeID. Leads with intent_score>=0.7 -> SDR-High, 0.4-0.7 -> SDR-Nurture, <0.4 -> marketing drip. I can add HubSpot workflow + webhook for webinar regs.

ads-bot: Reminder: creatives_due Tue 17:00 PST. :bell:

amanda_g: Can someone update the GA/UTM sheet and share? Raj — please add daypart multipliers. Leo — add creative ID mapping. I'll loop in Growth Ops and Ops for lead routing.

raj_k: On it. Initial budget config: ```{ "brand": 50, "high_intent": 100, "broad": 50 }``` Will iterate after first 48h.

leo: Creative plan: 2 headlines x 3 images + 2 CTAs. Rotation every 48h, holdout 10% control. We'll swap underperformers at 72h.

sarah_m: :thumbsup: I'll set routing and SDR tags. Quick Q — separate LP per creative or use query params to surface creative on same LP?

amanda_g: Prefer 2 LP variants A/B test; use query params for now to keep publishing fast. Let's sync 11:00am PT tomorrow if any blockers.

ads-bot: Scheduled reminder created for Tue 17:00 PST and 11:00am PT meeting invite.
